issues.code_location: BlobFeeMarket.java: BLOB_GAS_PRICE constant and blobGasPricePerGas() method
issues.description: The blob gas price calculation uses factor BLOB_GAS_PRICE = BigInteger.TWO (2) instead of MIN_BASE_FEE_PER_BLOB_GAS = 1. The method blobGasPricePerGas() calls fakeExponential(BLOB_GAS_PRICE, excessBlobGas, ...) while the spec requires fake_exponential(MIN_BASE_FEE_PER_BLOB_GAS=1, ...). The correct constant MIN_BLOB_GASPRICE = Wei.ONE is defined but unused.
issues.potential_impact: Blob base fee will be calculated as 2x the correct value for all excess_blob_gas values (e.g., 2 wei instead of 1 wei at genesis/excess=0). This causes consensus failure: blocks valid on spec-compliant clients will be rejected and vice versa, transaction validation of max_fee_per_blob_gas will diverge, and users will be overcharged for blob gas.
issues.suggestion: Change BLOB_GAS_PRICE to BigInteger.ONE or use MIN_BLOB_GASPRICE value (1) as the factor in blobGasPricePerGas(): fakeExponential(BigInteger.ONE, excessBlobGas.toBigInteger(), getBaseFeeUpdateFraction()). Remove or consolidate duplicate constants.

summary: The fakeExponential loop logic matches the spec, but the blob gas price factor is 2 instead of the specified MIN_BASE_FEE_PER_BLOB_GAS=1. This doubles all blob base fees and will cause consensus divergence from spec-compliant clients.
